Hi Lena — thanks for the sample. Short answer: portal-first, email-acceptable with clear conventions. Details below so your AP can standardize quickly.

Portal vs email
- Portal (preferred): best for automated PO matching and faster ACKs. If you can enroll all entities into the portal that avoids manual steps.
- Email (fallback): invoices@redwood.ai is fine for the first 60 days during onboarding; after that we ask active suppliers to use the portal.

Email requirements (if you send PDFs)
- Subject token: include PO:<PO_NUMBER> (exact string "PO:") or the PO number as the first token in the subject. Both patterns work but please avoid free-text prefixes (e.g., "Invoice for"). Examples we parse reliably: "PO:12345", "PO: 12345" or "12345" as first token.
- File name: start with the invoice date and PO when available, e.g. "2025-10-31_PO12345_LUMO.pdf".
- Multi-entity routing: include a top-level field on the first page called "BillToEntity:" with the legal entity short-code (US / EU / APAC). If BillToEntity is missing we will route to the default entity tied to the PO.

Remit fields (recommended)
- RemitName
- RemitAddressLine1
- RemitCity
- RemitCountry
- RemitTaxId (where applicable)
- Currency on the invoice header

Attachments & sample template
- I've attached a small CSV we use internally for remit mapping (sample-remit-template.csv) — please use that to confirm field positions.

Next steps
1) Enroll each legal entity in the vendor portal (https://redwood.enterprise.onboarding/form/vendor-enroll-CTK23).
2) If portal enrollment will take >30 days, please send a batch of email-submitted invoices with the subject pattern above and include BillToEntity on page 1.
3) Send a confirmation and one example per entity so we can validate auto-routing.

If helpful I can loop in Finance (Marcus) to confirm ledger mapping for Lumosupply's three entities.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample-remit-template.csv (CSV, 2KB)
